summary: A 'theory' that simply echoes every observed value with one free parameter per observable. It fits perfectly (delta_log_likelihood high) but is a gaming attempt: a parsimony probe. BIC/MDL must rank it BELOW the parsimonious resolver, even though its raw fit is perfect.

pillars.name: free-parameter-per-observable
pillars.claim: Each observable is set by its own independent free parameter.
assumptions: no predictive content; one knob per data point
falsifiers: any held-out observable it was not fit to

notes: Parsimony probe: raw fit is perfect but BIC (k*ln(n)) penalizes the 7 free parameters. The Phase-1 falsifiability anchor will also flag 'no held-out predictive content'.
